svg.title: lambda-gpu-llm
svg.desc: An image builder pushes Lambda's vLLM image with and without Qwen3-8B-FP8 to ECR and copies the weights to S3; three functions on GPU Lambda Managed Instances load the weights from Hugging Face, S3, or their image.
